calls.answer: {"status": "unsupported", "tasks": [], "questions": [], "error": "ARM ONE (arm_01) has no actuator named telescope_joint. Its actuators are base_yaw, shoulder, elbow, wrist (revolute, rad) and gripper (prismatic, 0.0-0.08 m). It has no telescoping or extending link, and the only prismatic joint is the gripper, which has a maximum travel of 0.08 m. That is less than the requested 0.2 m. Extending a telescope_joint by 0.2 m is therefore not a supported capability. If you meant to move the tool 0.2 m in a particular direction, give the target tool position [x,y,z] in metres in the world frame, or give target joint values for the existing actuators."}
